name: field-types
body: Field types: `text` (inline Markdown following the same inline rules as bodies — bold, italic, inline code, `[]()` links, hard breaks; `[]()` links inside text are validated exactly like body links, so a `#label` must exist; `plain` flag strips styles silently), `number` (written as a plain YAML number, e.g. `1250000`, `0.12`; a quoted/string value = type error), `date` (written as `YYYY-MM-DD`; any other form = error), `boolean`, `enum`, `image` (path under assets/, existence checked), `link` (#label checked or http(s) URL), `list` (exactly one item descriptor), and a section template used as a field type for structured YAML data (e.g. `people: {type: list, item: {type: person}}`). Every type accepts the `nullable` rule (nullable-fields). A field's `type:` names one of these types; a `record` appears as a list's `item:` descriptor — `item: {type: record, fields: [...]}` (record-item-type) — so structured data comes either from a section template used as a field type or from such an inline record.
